Media Metadata Manager 1.4.0

  • Free disk space check: pressing Start now estimates the room the waiting files will take on the disks they are written to. If a disk is short, a dialog offers Change Target…, Skip These Files, Run Anyway or Cancel; a merge checks the same before it starts. It also counts the safety copy and optimize rewrite of files edited where they sit, and a delivery to a library folder on another disk. Edit > Save and Save As stop with a clear message if the disk is too full, and a run started by Auto-Start does not begin if a disk is short (the status line says why; press Start to choose what to do). Turn it off in Settings > Media Intake.
  • Review Show for TV folders: double-click a season or show folder heading on the TV Shows tab to say which show and season it is (with a Look Up button that shows what the TV provider finds). Every episode in the folder is then searched with that show and season, and each episode's number is read from its file name.
  • Edit no longer drops the row: opening a waiting file for editing from the Queue and then cancelling or closing without saving leaves it in the Queue as it was (it shows *Editing* meanwhile, and is not run). Only a save takes the row out. A row left in *Editing* by a quit comes back as waiting.
  • Queue names: a long name is cut in the middle so its ending stays visible, the tooltip shows the full path, and the Name column can be dragged wider.
  • Welcome window: *Window > Welcome to M3* brings it back, and clicking the Dock icon with no window open shows it. *File > New* is gone, since nothing in M3 is made from scratch.
  • Queue folder rows, files you can pick: the files listed under an open folder row can now be selected (one folder at a time), dragged into a new order, and follow the column you sort by (name, size or kind). With two or more picked, Merge merges just those files, the same way as opening the folder's merge order.
  • Queue fixes (loose ends): a stamped name that was numbered on a collision (`..._720p 2`) is read like the original; the finished file's address follows a whole-folder move into the library, so Edit and Save look in the right place; Clean up processed files now also covers a plain Queue item whose finished file is a different file from the one added; naming and tagging search the Queue's chosen movie provider first, so a name approved from one source is tagged from the same one.
  • Show and season from folder names: a file with no episode marker in its name, in a season folder (`Show/Season 2/05 - Title.mkv`), now fills the show, season and episode in the metadata search. A waiting Queue item whose file has been moved or deleted shows File missing in the Status column.
  • "Preferences" is now "Settings" in the app's own wording: messages, tooltips, the menu item and the guides say Settings, as macOS does since version 13 (macOS 12 and earlier call it Preferences).
  • Sets by rule: Settings > Sets has a Set Rules... button. A rule applies a Metadata Set when a file's tags match its conditions (for example Content Rating is Explicit applies your Adult Set). The first enabled matching rule wins; the Queue applies it after the online search.
  • Copy in the Trash when saving an edit (optional, off by default): Settings > Sources > Intake can keep a copy of the file as it was in the Trash before an Edit + Save changes it.
  • Path mapping for library servers: the Library scan has a Path Mapping... button when a library server is the Source. When the server lists its files by a path that differs from the Mac's (a network drive mounted under another name, a Windows or NAS path), one or more "server path -> folder on this Mac" mappings make the files findable. The sheet shows an example path the server listed.

Media Metadata Manager 1.3.1

  • New: the Library scan has a Source choice when a plugin for your own media server (a library server) is installed. Scan it and the list shows only the files where the server has something the file lacks, in orange; a movie whose file is not at the server's path shows "File not found".
  • New: Accept writes the server's values straight into the files, one tag at a time (right-click an orange cell), for the selected files, or for all of them. A copy of each file is kept until its write works.
  • New: files sent from a library-server scan to the Queue are filled from the server's own item for each file (no search), adding only the tags the file lacks.
  • Improved: Edit… on an orange cell starts with the server's value.
  • Changed: Preferences → Sources keeps the two kinds of source apart. In Providers, a plugin for your own media server is listed in its own Library Servers column (shown only when one is installed) instead of among the movie providers; in Custom Sources, the list has Online and Library Servers headings (also only when a library server plugin is installed).

Media Metadata Manager 1.3.0

  • Improved: the screenshots in the User Guide, the Getting Started Guide and the Help window were all retaken from the current version, so each window shown matches what you see: Preferences, the Queue with its review windows (naming, metadata, merge order) and Options panel, the Library scan, the editor and its metadata search, and the Message Log.
  • New: the User Guide's "Searching for metadata" section now shows the Search Metadata window with a result selected, and the Queue section shows an opened folder and the Library scan editing files in place.
  • Improved: the Word and PDF copies of both guides were rebuilt with the new pictures.
